english: Skeleton soldiers have been appearing near the village.
korean: 마을 근처에 해골 병사들이 나타나고 있어요.

english: They're scaring away the merchants and travelers.
Could you defeat one of them for me?
Yes
Thank you! Please be careful out there.
No
I understand. It's dangerous work.
Have you defeated the skeleton soldier yet?
You defeated one! The village will be safer now.
korean: 한 마리를 처치했군요! 마을이 더 안전해질 거예요.

english: The roads are safer thanks to you!
Defeat the Skeleton Soldier
Skeleton soldiers are threatening the village. Defeat one of them to protect the merchants and travelers.
korean: 해골 병사들이 마을을 위협하고 있습니다. 상인과 여행자를 보호하기 위해 한 마리를 처치하세요.

english: Defeat a skeleton soldier

Can you deliver this healing potion to him?
Yes
Thank you! He really needs this.
No
Oh I see. I hope I can find someone else.
Did Jhon send you?
This potion will help me recover. Thank you so much!
korean: 이 포션으로 회복할 수 있겠어요. 정말 감사합니다!

english: Deliver the Healing Potion
Bob is sick and needs a healing potion. Deliver the potion from Jhon to Bob.
korean: 밥이 아파서 치료 포션이 필요합니다. 존의 포션을 밥에게 전달하세요.

english: Deliver the healing potion to Bob
Business has been slow lately.
My back is killing me from standing all day.
Did you hear about the monster sightings near the forest?
I used to be an adventurer like you.
The weather's been strange this week.
My daughter wants to become a mage.
I've been running this shop for 20 years now.
korean: 이 가게를 운영한 지 벌써 20년이 됐네요.

english: Sometimes I miss the old days.
The mayor raised taxes again. Unbelievable.
korean: 시장이 또 세금을 올렸어요. 말도 안되죠.

english: I heard a rumor about treasure in the old ruins.
korean: 옛 유적에 보물이 있다는 소문을 들었어요.

english: Been hammering iron since dawn. I'm exhausted.
My apprentice quit yesterday. Kids these days.
korean: 어제 제자가 그만뒀어요. 요즘 애들은 말이죠.

english: This heat never bothers me anymore.
korean: 이제 이 더위는 신경도 안 쓰여요.

english: I made my first sword when I was just 12 years old.
My wife keeps nagging me to retire.
Nothing beats the smell of hot metal in the morning.
korean: 아침에 맡는 뜨거운 쇠 냄새만한 게 없죠.

english: I once forged a sword for the king himself.
korean: 한때 왕을 위해 검을 만든 적이 있어요.

english: These old hands aren't what they used to be.
korean: 이 늙은 손이 예전 같지 않아요.

english: Heard some bandits on the road lately. Be careful.
Sometimes I talk to my hammer. Don't judge me.
korean: 가끔 망치한테 말을 걸어요. 이상하게 보지 마세요.
